item.title: Summer Sizzle Fun at Dodge Community Center
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Summer Sizzle Fun at Dodge Community Center

Celebrate a successful summer camp season for campers and camp counselors alike! Join us for Summer Sizzle tomorrow, Thursday, Aug. 1, from 4-8 p.m. at Dodge Community Center*, located at 667 Sullivant Ave., 43215. 

There will be free food while supplies last, a fun zone with inflatable games and an art gallery display. This will be immediately followed by a talent show featuring campers highlighting some of what they did this summer. 

All are welcome, whether or not you attended camp. It's sure to be an afternoon filled with fun, laughter and unforgettable memories!

*Please note: The event has been moved from Wolfe Park due to the potential for rain.

item.title: New Process to Complete Summer Camp Paperwork
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

New Process to Complete Summer Camp Paperwork

In case you missed it on the website and program materials, Columbus Recreation and Parks Department is using a new software solution to securely collect health and emergency contact information for summer camps - ePACT Network. This means no more paper forms and peace of mind that the department has the right health data to best support you!

ePACT is easy to use and will save you time. Having one central account for your family means your shared information will be pre-filled and notify the department when you make an update, ensuring summer camp staff has the most up-to-date information when it matters most. And you can be confident that your information is protected, as security and privacy are a top priority for ePACT. Read more about its privacy and security measures. 

You can expect an invitation from Columbus Recreation and Parks in the next few weeks for each member who is registered for an active program. You then simply create an ePACT account and follow the prompts. Watch a short video on how to do that. We'll also be sending you additional information once the program starts to set up contactless check-in!

While this is a change, we know that the use of ePACT Network will simplify the camp paperwork process for you, and ensure summer camp staff has the most up-to-date information so they’re prepared to respond to things like severe weather, delayed arrival from a field trip or an allergic reaction.

item.title: Three Columbus Recreation and Parks Pools to Open June 6
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Three Columbus Recreation and Parks Pools to Open June 6

Columbus Recreation and Parks Department is excited to announce the official opening date for three Columbus pools. Dodge, Driving Park and Tuttle pools will open for the summer June 6.

Dodge, Driving Park and Tuttle Pools 

June 6-10

1-4 p.m. and 4:30-7:30 p.m.

Due to capacity limits, advance registration is strongly encouraged but not required. You can register online at columbusrecparks.com/facilities/pools.

The department is working on setting the schedule for the outdoor pools for the rest of the summer and plans to post more information in the coming days.

Come Work as a Lifeguard!

If you enjoy keeping your community safe and are looking for a summer job, the department is still looking for lifeguards for the summer. Starting pay is $17 per hour, and the department will offer free lifeguard training for those who work at a City of Columbus pool. Two certification classes are scheduled for next week, and one certification class is scheduled for the week after.

For more information, call 614-645-6122, email aquaticcenter@columbus.gov or go online.

item.title: Summer Camp Spots Still Available for CRPD Fitness Camp!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Sign Up Today for CRPD Fitness Camp!

CRPD Fitness Camp is an eight-week, day-long camp that is so much fun for campers ages five to 15! Students participate in a variety of activities, from fitness training, sports, swimming lessons, group games, creative arts and more.

There are still slots available for campers at Blackburn, Douglas and Glenwood community centers. Camp hours are 7 a.m.-6 p.m. from June 13-Aug. 5. Campers must have completed kindergarten by June 6 of this year and be no older than 15 by that date. 

You can register your kids at 1111 E. Broad St., Monday-Friday from 8 a.m.-5 p.m. until Friday, May 13. Please bring the application and requested documents.

Learn more about CRPD Fitness Camp.

item.title: Registration for Community Recreation and Therapeutic Recreation Camps Begins Tomorrow!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Registration for Community Recreation and Therapeutic Recreation Camps Begins Tomorrow!

Looking for fun and safe summer activities for your child? Look no further than Columbus Recreation and Parks Department's summer camps! Campers participate in a wide variety of activities, including arts, crafts, sports, games, science experiments and nature exploration. You can register for one session or for the entire summer. Learn more information about summer camps by visiting the department’s new website at columbusrecparks.com/camps.

We hope you’ll spend your summer with us this year! Check out the website or visit your local community center for more information.

Key Dates

Plan your summer activities now so you are ready to register!

Community Recreation Camps

  • Operate from early June to mid-August, with various start and end dates for multiple camps.
  • Tuesday, March 1, at 7 p.m.
  • In-person registration is Tuesday, March 1, 7-8:45 p.m. at your local community center.

Therapeutic Recreation Camps

  • Operate from June 13 to mid-August
  • Online registration begins Tuesday, March 1, at 3 p.m.
  • In-person registration is Tuesday, March 1, 3-7 p.m. at Franklin Park Adventure Center, 1755 E. Broad St., 43203.

The safety of your camper and staff is the top priority. At this time, the COVID-19 safety protocols in place state masks are required in all City buildings, and participants, visitors and staff are encouraged to practice social distancing. As these protocols may change based on updated guidance, please watch for information about what protocols will be followed during camp closer to the start of the first session. Information will be shared via email, social media, building signage and materials sent home with campers.

If you have any questions or need additional information, visit columbusrecparks.com/camps or call 614-645-7000.

Here’s to another fun and engaging summer!
